name: Callair A-series
summary: Wyoming-built cabin tourer that evolved into one of the first purpose-built crop dusters. It is unusual for combining a braced low wing, a tailwheel and a fabric cabin.

wings: Low wing braced to the fuselage by struts on each side
engines: Single Lycoming flat-four in a simple cowl
fuselage: Fabric-covered tube fuselage with a two- to three-seat cabin; ag versions have a hopper
tail: Horizontal tail on the rear fuselage

tellTales: Strut-braced low wing on a tailwheel airplane, which is rare
Fabric-covered cabin or ag airframe with struts under each wing
Older piston low-wing duster with a flat-engine nose

confusedWith.howToTell: The A-9 is the later single-seat hopper airplane with a bigger flat-six; the A-series are the earlier two- to three-seat cabin and early ag variants.
The Pawnee is a similar strut-braced low-wing ag plane with a Piper-style tail and a single-seat raised cockpit; the A-series often keeps a cabin.
The 140 is a high-wing; this is a low-wing with struts below the wing.
